title: How Wildreach Plays
description: Four ranges, one quiet battlefield — assemble a deck, outmaneuver rivals in turn-based duels, and climb the seasonal ladder while you observe the hunt.

pillars.title: Range Tactics
pillars.description: Trade lines on a living board where timing, territorial pressure, and burst windows matter more than raw stats. Win the turn before you win the hunt.

pillars.title: Predator Collecting
pillars.description: Pull hunters from Serengeti, Bengal, Patagonia, and Taiga — then stitch keywords, curves, and finishers into a list that rewards patience.

pillars.title: Seasonal Ladder
pillars.description: Climb seasonal tiers, learn from losses, and refine your lines. The summit rewards observers who adapt without losing the range.
